_sources: provisions: 1961 s.4 'Charge of income-tax' (thc arrangement p.1) / 2025 s.4 (Gazette 265620 p.24). summary: S2 s.4(1), (2); the rate tables RATE-SLAB-NEW-TAX-REGIME (s.202(1)) and RATE-SLAB-FIRST-SCHEDULE* (First Schedule, Finance Act). routes[0]: RATE-SLAB-NEW-TAX-REGIME. routes[1]: the three First Schedule ladders (W-046, W-046b). disqualifiers[0]: s.4(4); TaxYearId is the unit of computation.
summary: Income-tax is charged on the total income of the tax year at the rates the year's Finance Act sets: the default regime's slab rates, or, if you opt out, the other slab rates, which differ for senior and very senior citizens.

routes.name: The default regime
routes.description: Tax at the default regime's slab rates.

routes.name: The other rates
routes.description: Tax at the other slab rates, by your age at the end of the year.

disqualifiers.description: Income the Act charges for a period other than the tax year.
